text_block_list.text:
The distinguished autumn Tenno Sho has
arrived,
and Бива Хаяхидэ examines my
face closely
while we're in the prep
room.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Since she's a worrier at heart, she can't
help but
check to see if I've been
keeping my promise to
get more sleЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Satisfied that I am, she heads to the
race, ready
to prove the effectiveness of
the winning
equation we've built
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
